name: io.github.codespar/mcp-cpfcnpj
description: MCP server for cpfcnpj.com.br — official Brazilian CPF and CNPJ lookups in real time (D+0), no leaked or scraped databases

environmentVariables.name: CPFCNPJ_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Account token issued at cpfcnpj.com.br, used in the request path

environmentVariables.name: CPFCNPJ_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: API base URL, defaults to https://api.cpfcnpj.com.br. Override for testing.
